synthetic_notice: SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA. Every value in this package was generated by a formula for interface testing. It describes no real place on the Moon and no real date. Do not use it, quote it or present it as a result.

horizon.elevation.title: SYNTHETIC - terrain horizon
horizon.elevation.definition: Elevation angle of the terrain horizon per azimuth and observer height.
horizon.elevation.algorithm: Invented closed-form formula in lsncore/synthetic.py. Not a computation from data.
horizon.elevation.frame: local East/North/Up of the site; up is the sphere normal
limits: Synthetic sample value. Not valid for any use other than testing readers.

horizon.obstacle.title: SYNTHETIC - horizon obstacle
horizon.obstacle.definition: Location of the terrain point that sets the horizon in each azimuth.
horizon.obstacle.algorithm: Invented closed-form formula in lsncore/synthetic.py. Not a computation from data.
limits: Synthetic sample value. Not valid for any use other than testing readers.

horizon.obstacles.title: SYNTHETIC - obstacles
horizon.obstacles.definition: Runs of neighbouring azimuths whose horizon is set by the same piece of terrain.

horizon.obstacles.frame: local East/North/Up of the site; up is the sphere normal
limits: Synthetic sample value. Not valid for any use other than testing readers.
